diagnosis.reasoning: Request rate actually fell 83% while prompt token rate held roughly flat, so the load did not grow — yet prefix cache hit rate collapsed from 0.85 to 0.10, meaning nearly every prompt token must now be computed and stored (prefill_kv_computed_p99 ~4450, kv_cache_usage 0.09 -> 0.81). KV pressure, mild preemption, deep queueing, and the drop in running requests/generation rate are all downstream of that cache-reuse collapse feeding prefill cost and memory. Hence prefix_cache_efficacy is the root cause, with kv_cache_pressure and prefill_cost as its immediate effects.
